---
title: "Landscape quote checker"
description: "Got a quote for topsoil, mulch, gravel or road base? See what depth it actually covers, whether it's more than you need, and the real price per yard and per ton."
anchor-sections: false
include-in-header: _hm-head.html
---

Enter your area, the depth you want, and up to three quotes. The checker shows the depth each quote would actually cover, whether it's more (or less) than you need, and the price per unit, so quotes in yards, tons and bags can be compared fairly.

```{=html}
<div class="hmc" id="qc"></div>
<script>
(function () {
  const MATS = {
    topsoil: ['Topsoil', 1.30, 15], compost: ['Compost', 0.65, 15], gardenmix: ['Garden / raised-bed mix', 1.00, 20],
    mulch: ['Shredded bark mulch', 0.40, 10], chips: ['Wood chips', 0.35, 10], gravel: ['Gravel / crushed rock', 1.60, 5],
    roadbase: ['Road base / crusher fines', 1.75, 25], sand: ['Sand', 1.55, 15], rock: ['River rock', 1.50, 5]
  };
  const UNITS = [['yd3', 'cubic yards'], ['ton', 'tons (US)'], ['m3', 'cubic metres'], ['t', 'tonnes'], ['bag', 'bags']];
  const quote = n => [
    { t: 'sec', l: `Quote ${n}${n > 1 ? ' (optional)' : ''}` },
    { k: `q${n}`, l: 'Quantity', t: 'num', w: 3 },
    { k: `u${n}`, l: 'Unit', t: 'select', opts: UNITS, d: { us: 'yd3', si: 'm3' }, w: 3 },
    { k: `b${n}`, l: 'Bag size', t: 'cuft', d: { us: 2, si: 50 }, show: v => v[`u${n}`] === 'bag' },
    { k: `p${n}`, l: 'Total price, including delivery and tax', t: 'money', h: n === 1 ? 'Use the all-in price you would actually pay.' : '' }
  ];
  HM.tool({
    id: 'qc', step: 'Your job',
    inputs: [
      { k: 'mat', l: 'Material', t: 'select', opts: Object.entries(MATS).map(([k, m]) => [k, m[0]]), d: 'topsoil' },
      { k: 'area', l: 'Area to cover', t: 'area', w: 3, h: 'Odd shape? Work it out in the <a href="materials-calculator.qmd">materials calculator</a>.' },
      { k: 'dep', l: 'Depth you want', t: 'dep', d: { us: 4, si: 10 }, w: 3 },
      ...quote(1), ...quote(2), ...quote(3)
    ],
    compute(v, U) {
      const [name, dens, extra] = MATS[v.mat], X = extra / 100;
      if (!(v.area > 0) || !(v.dep > 0)) return U.empty('Enter your area and depth.');
      const need = v.area * v.dep * (1 + X); // loose m³
      const rows = [], work = [`Loose volume you need = ${U.f(v.area, 'area', 0)} × ${U.f(v.dep, 'dep')} × ${HM.fmt(1 + X, 2)} (${extra}% for settling) = ${U.f(need, 'vol')}`];
      for (let n = 1; n <= 3; n++) {
        const q = v[`q${n}`], p = v[`p${n}`], un = v[`u${n}`];
        if (!(q > 0)) continue;
        let V;
        if (un === 'yd3') V = q * 0.764554858; else if (un === 'm3') V = q;
        else if (un === 'ton') V = q * 0.90718474 / dens; else if (un === 't') V = q / dens;
        else V = q * (v[`b${n}`] || 0);
        if (!(V > 0)) continue;
        const depth = V / (1 + X) / v.area, ratio = V / need;
        const perV = p > 0 ? p / U.val(V, 'vol') : null, perT = p > 0 ? p / (U.us ? V * dens / 0.90718474 : V * dens) : null;
        const fair = p > 0 ? p / V * need : null;
        rows.push({ n, V, depth, ratio, perV, perT, fair, p });
        work.push(`Quote ${n}: ${HM.fmt(q, 2)} ${UNITS.find(x => x[0] === un)[1]} = ${U.f(V, 'vol')} loose${un === 'ton' || un === 't' ? ` (at ${U.f(dens, 'dens')})` : ''}; covers ${U.f(V, 'vol')} ÷ ${HM.fmt(1 + X, 2)} ÷ ${U.f(v.area, 'area', 0)} = ${U.f(depth, 'dep', 1)}`);
      }
      if (!rows.length) return { html: U.big('You need', U.f(need, 'vol') + ' loose', `≈ ${U.f(need * dens, 'ton', 1)}. Enter a quote below to check it.`), work };
      const tag = r => r.ratio > 1.25 ? `<span class="tag bad">${HM.fmt((r.ratio - 1) * 100, 0)}% more than needed</span>` : r.ratio < 0.95 ? `<span class="tag warn">${HM.fmt((1 - r.ratio) * 100, 0)}% short</span>` : '<span class="tag good">About right</span>';
      const priced = rows.filter(r => r.perV != null), best = priced.length > 1 ? Math.min(...priced.map(r => r.perV)) : null;
      let h = U.big('You need', U.f(need, 'vol') + ' loose', `To cover ${U.f(v.area, 'area', 0)} at ${U.f(v.dep, 'dep')}, including ${extra}% for settling. That weighs about ${U.f(need * dens, 'ton', 1)}.`);
      h += `<table class="tt"><thead><tr><th>Quote</th><th>Covers</th><th class="r">Per ${U.us ? 'yd³' : 'm³'}</th><th class="r">Per ${U.us ? 'ton' : 'tonne'}</th></tr></thead><tbody>` +
        rows.map(r => `<tr><td>${r.n}<br>${tag(r)}</td><td>${U.f(r.depth, 'dep', 1)} deep</td><td class="r"${best != null && r.perV === best ? ' style="color:var(--good);font-weight:700"' : ''}>${r.perV != null ? U.money(r.perV) : '–'}</td><td class="r">${r.perT != null ? U.money(r.perT) : '–'}</td></tr>`).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
      const notes = [];
      rows.forEach(r => {
        if (r.ratio > 1.25) notes.push(U.note(`Quote ${r.n} is enough for about ${U.f(r.depth, 'dep', 1)}, not ${U.f(v.dep, 'dep')}. Ask why, or ask for ${U.f(need, 'vol', 1)} instead.${r.fair ? ` At the same unit price that would cost about ${U.money(r.fair)}.` : ''}`, 'bad'));
        if (r.ratio < 0.95) notes.push(U.note(`Quote ${r.n} only covers about ${U.f(r.depth, 'dep', 1)}. Check whether the depth or the area was misunderstood.`));
      });
      if (best != null) notes.push(U.note('Prices per unit include delivery, so small loads look expensive per unit. Compare quotes for the same quantity where you can.', 'good'));
      h += notes.join('');
      rows.forEach(r => { if (r.perV != null) work.push(`Quote ${r.n} unit price = ${U.money(r.p)} ÷ ${U.f(r.V, 'vol')} = ${U.money(r.perV)} per ${U.us ? 'yd³' : 'm³'}`); });
      return { html: h, work };
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

## Yards and tons converter

Soil and mulch are usually sold by the cubic yard; stone, gravel and sand by the ton. This converts between them, and shows what an amount will cover.

```{=html}
<div class="hmc" id="conv"></div>
<script>
(function () {
  const MATS = {
    topsoil: ['Topsoil', 1.30], compost: ['Compost', 0.65], gardenmix: ['Garden / raised-bed mix', 1.00], mulch: ['Shredded bark mulch', 0.40],
    chips: ['Wood chips', 0.35], gravel: ['Gravel / crushed rock', 1.60], roadbase: ['Road base / crusher fines', 1.75], sand: ['Sand', 1.55], rock: ['River rock', 1.50]
  };
  HM.tool({
    id: 'conv', step: 'Convert', hash: false,
    inputs: [
      { k: 'mat', l: 'Material', t: 'select', opts: Object.entries(MATS).map(([k, m]) => [k, m[0]]), d: 'topsoil' },
      { k: 'dens', l: 'Weight (loose)', t: 'dens', d: (u, v) => { const m = MATS[(v && v.mat) || 'topsoil']; return u === 'us' ? Math.round(m[1] / 1.18655 * 100) / 100 : m[1]; }, h: 'Typical value. Ask your supplier for theirs: it varies with moisture.' },
      { k: 'q', l: 'Amount', t: 'num', w: 3 },
      { k: 'un', l: 'Unit', t: 'select', opts: [['yd3', 'cubic yards'], ['ton', 'tons (US)'], ['m3', 'cubic metres'], ['t', 'tonnes'], ['cuft', 'cubic feet']], d: { us: 'yd3', si: 'm3' }, w: 3 }
    ],
    onChange(k, api) { if (k === 'mat') { const m = MATS[api.get('mat')]; api.setDisp('dens', api.units() === 'us' ? Math.round(m[1] / 1.18655 * 100) / 100 : m[1]); } },
    compute(v, U) {
      if (!(v.q > 0) || !(v.dens > 0)) return U.empty('Enter an amount.');
      const V = v.un === 'yd3' ? v.q * 0.764554858 : v.un === 'm3' ? v.q : v.un === 'cuft' ? v.q * 0.0283168466 : v.un === 'ton' ? v.q * 0.90718474 / v.dens : v.q / v.dens;
      const t = V * v.dens;
      const deps = U.us ? [1, 2, 3, 4, 6] : [2.5, 5, 7.5, 10, 15];
      const cover = deps.map(d => [`at ${d} ${U.us ? 'in' : 'cm'}`, U.f(V / (d * (U.us ? 0.0254 : 0.01)), 'area', 0)]);
      return {
        html: U.big('Equals', `${HM.fmt(V / 0.764554858, 2)} yd³ · ${HM.fmt(t / 0.90718474, 2)} tons`, `${HM.fmt(V, 2)} m³ · ${HM.fmt(t, 2)} tonnes · ${HM.fmt(V / 0.0283168466, 0)} ft³ · ${HM.fmt(V / 0.0566336932, 0)} bags of 2 ft³`) +
          '<h3>Area it covers</h3>' + U.kv(cover),
        work: [`Volume = ${U.f(V, 'vol')}`, `Weight = volume × ${U.f(v.dens, 'dens')} = ${U.f(t, 'ton')}`, `Coverage = volume ÷ depth`]
      };
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

## Why quotes are hard to compare

- **Yards vs tons.** A cubic yard of mulch weighs a few hundred pounds; a cubic yard of gravel weighs well over a ton. A price per ton and a price per yard can't be compared unless you know what the material weighs. The checker converts using typical weights; ask the supplier for theirs.
- **Delivery.** A delivery fee spread over a small load makes the price per unit look high. Compare quotes for the same quantity.
- **Extra for settling.** Loose material settles after spreading, so a fair quote includes a little more than the measured volume, usually 5–25% depending on the material. A quote for double what you need is not "a little extra".
- **Bags.** Bag sizes vary (1, 1.5, 2 or 3 cubic feet). Check the bag size before comparing bag prices.

Use the [materials calculator](materials-calculator.qmd) to work out exactly how much you need for an odd-shaped area.
